verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an accounting SaaS, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The crawl note explicitly says Wave's public pages document no webhook surface, and the developer portal returned 403, so it could not be checked. In-app invoice status alerts ('Know when an invoice is viewed...') are user notifications, not programmatic webhooks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
